description: Zodiac crystal constellation orb detail images for collection modal display

styleGuide.description: High-detail translucent magical spheres with intricate constellation patterns glowing inside. Larger format shows more detail in the crystal facets and star arrangements.

elements.orb: Highly detailed translucent crystal sphere with visible glass-like facets and internal reflections
elements.constellation: Detailed connected star pattern with major and minor stars visible within the orb
elements.glow: Rich element-appropriate color aura with subtle particle effects
elements.stars: Bright glowing points with light rays for major stars
elements.backdrop: Dark mystical background to enhance the orb's luminosity

fire.glow: fiery amber aura with ember particles

earth.glow: verdant green aura with leaf-like particles

air.glow: ethereal silver-blue aura with wisp particles

water.glow: mystical indigo aura with bubble particles
